request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Kegwick Firestarter".

Creative brief
Name: Kegwick Firestarter
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A delayed area attacker that rolls burning powder kegs across open ground.
Body and silhouette: Small bundled raider with a round hood, thick gloves, and a keg carried against the chest.
Signature features: Smoking fuse, soot-blackened goggles, and a belt of ceramic spark pots.
Palette and materials: Dark leather, barrel brown, soot gray, and controlled orange flame.
Movement personality: Nervous, hurried, and recklessly enthusiastic.
Attack concept: Rolls a keg in a straight line; it slows visibly before bursting into eight short-range sparks.
Directional details: A bundle of spare fuses is tied to the right side of the belt.
Avoid: Modern dynamite, enormous explosion cloud, comedic clown appearance.
